title: Commissionerate of Entrance Examinations, Kerala
raw_text: Commissionerate of Entrance Examinations, Kerala CEE Kerala Home About Us Courses Notifications Press Releases Academic News General RTI മലയാളം Commissionerate Of Entrance Examinations Govt. of Kerala, Thiruvananthapuram Commissionerate of Entrance Examinations A Brief Note About Us Commissionerate of Entrance Examinations The Commissionerate of Entrance Examinations (CEE) Kerala is a statutory authority under the Government of Kerala responsible for conducting entrance examinations and administering centralized admissions to professional courses in the state. It ensures a transparent, fair, and merit-based admission process in strict compliance with government policies and reservation norms. The Commissionerate manages the complete admission workflow, from notification and application to rank list publication and seat allotment. Through robust digital platforms, CEE Kerala enhances efficiency, accessibility, and accountability in public service delivery.
